note: No Instagram account connected. Trends are what is currently popular in these three domains, not a platform-wide census.
source: public Instagram trend discovery (social.search, platform=instagram, ranked by engagement)

trends.details: A 94K-like carousel leads with a floor-length oversized burgundy faux-fur coat worn over a sheer leopard-print bodysuit, and a 47K-like lookbook styles a light beige faux-fur hooded jacket open over a striped hoodie with pink sweatpants and silver sneakers. A 5.5K-like 'NOVEMBER OUTFITS' montage cycles through about 15 layered looks — burgundy leather midi skirt, beige trench coat, burgundy double-breasted coat, fur-collar brown leather coat — past luxury storefronts, while the cropped brown faux-fur jacket over a black lace bralette keeps resurfacing in subway looks.
trends.title: Burgundy faux fur goes floor-length — oversized coats, leopard print, November outfit montages

trends.details: A 4.6K-like 'Decorate for Christmas with me' reel layers burgundy velvet bows, crystal trees, garland with lights over an arched mirror and stockings under a Santa-painting mantel; an 8.3K-like reel rebuilds a gift display beneath a black marble fireplace, and a 7.2K-like showroom tour assembles a white flocked tree with warm white lights. How-to content keeps pace — a 6.1K-like Michaels guide compares gold tinsel trees and mercury-glass ornaments — while an 11K-like 'Dear 2027, I am ready' reel in red plaid pajamas already sets a New Year table.
trends.title: Christmas decorating goes full burgundy-and-green — crystal trees, flocked trees, tree guides

trends.details: The day's biggest beauty post is a 75K-like 'winterkissed makeup' reel — voluminous curled brown hair, glossy lips, heavy pink blush, shimmery pink eyeshadow and winged liner. A 2.6K-like '90s plum tutorial skips bronzer entirely, pairing MERIT mauve cream shadow with a nude-brown liner, Poundcake plum gloss and Gucci berry blush, while a 3K-like fall routine layers Rhode Pocket Bronze with Westman Atelier contour for an everyday warm glow.
trends.title: 'Winterkissed' makeup goes viral — glossy lips, heavy pink blush, shimmery pink eyes
